# crosswork_assign_ports_to_port_group (Resource)

This resource makes a list of ports that are members of a port group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_assign_ports_to_port_group" "example" {
  group_id = "16f9288d-ab96-4ea5-8593-94b30cbf00ee"
  ports = [
    {
      device    = "build-router-1"
      port_name = "GigabitEthernet0/0/0/0"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Id of the port group
- `ports` (Attributes Set) The ports that are members of the group; an empty list removes them all (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `device` (String) Inventory id of the device that has the port
- `port_name` (String) Name of the port on the device

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_assign_ports_to_port_group.example "<group_id>"
```
